directive: Say at a brisk, lively pace, like a warm confident cooking-show narrator:

lines.text: Pad kra pao. Salty, fiery, holy basil first.
lines.stt: Pad kra pow, salty, fiery, holy basil first.

lines.text: Pound chillies and garlic. Keep it coarse.
lines.stt: Pound chillies and garlic. Keep it coarse.

lines.text: Minced pork with some fat. Extra lean dries out.
lines.stt: Minced pork with some fat, extra lean dries out.

lines.text: Season with fish sauce. Look for nam pla thae.
lines.stt: Season with fish sauce. Look for nam pla tae.

lines.text: A little pepper. The 1954 recipe pounds twenty peppercorns.
lines.stt: A little pepper. The 1954 recipe pounds 20 peppercorns.
lines.note: take b used; first take transcribed once as "calls for" and once as "pounds"

lines.text: Holy basil goes in last. Stir until just wilted.
lines.stt: Holy basil goes in last. Stir until just wilted.

lines.text: On rice. Crisp fried egg. Chilli fish sauce.
lines.stt: On Rice, Crisp Fried Egg, Chili Fish Sauce.

lines.text: In Thailand? Affiliate link in bio. Elsewhere, try your Asian grocer.
lines.stt: In Thailand, affiliate link in bio. Elsewhere, try your Asian grocer.
